title: NFL Football
description:
New York Jets at New England Patriots
The New York Jets (2-3) visit the New England Patriots (3-2) in Week 6 after both teams won last week. New York beat Cleveland 17-12 behind Geno Smith, while Drake Maye threw four touchdown passes in New England's 45-17 win over Las Vegas.

title: NFL Football
description:
Buffalo Bills at Las Vegas Raiders
The Las Vegas Raiders host the Buffalo Bills in Week 6. In week 5, Las Vegas lost 45-17 to the New England Patriots, leaving them at 3-2, while the Buffalo Bills beat the Los Angeles Rams 37-34 in overtime to improve to 4-1.
